description: Task counts grouped by status for each project.
purpose: Provides task breakdown per project for progress tracking dashboards.
fromSql: SELECT tpm_ts_project_id AS project_id, tpm_ts_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_tpm_task WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY tpm_ts_project_id, tpm_ts_status ORDER BY tpm_ts_project_id, CASE tpm_ts_status WHEN 'todo' THEN 1 WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 2 WHEN 'in_review' THEN 3 WHEN 'done' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

description: Reached milestone ratio for exactly one tenant-scoped project.
fromSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tpm_ms_status = 'reached') AS reached, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tpm_ms_status = 'pending') AS pending, COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tpm_ms_status = 'reached') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)), 0) AS progress FROM mt_tpm_milestone WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND tpm_ms_project_id = #{params.projectPid}

description: Actual milestone command activity joined to the parent project, scoped by tenant.
fromSql: SELECT a.pid, a.occurred_at, a.activity_type, a.actor_name, m.tpm_ms_name AS subject, a.content FROM ab_activity a JOIN mt_tpm_milestone m ON a.object_record = m.pid AND a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND a.object_model = 'tpm_milestone' AND m.tpm_ms_project_id = #{params.projectPid} ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC
